text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: To better understand her new rival, Tokai Teio, Mihono Bourbon watches old footage and learns her history of victories and upsets.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Anxious about Tokai Teio's comeback, she goes to the track to clear her mind, only to find Tokai Teio there.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: All her anxiety was for naught. Seeing Tokai Teio training with such passion and vigor instills her with courage.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After being awed by Tokai Teio's ability to inspire courage in others, she sets out to train with renewed drive.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As for Tokai Teio, she has been following Mihono Bourbon's success and views her as a new rival as well.
